Hi Jordan / team,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier — good discussion. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call highlights:
- Primary goals: reduce per-token inference cost for fraud-detection scoring, keep median latency < 120ms, and ensure data residency in AWS us-west-2.
- Current infra: in-house model orchestration on single-region infra; evaluating offloading inference to a managed partner to reduce ops burden.
- Security requirement: SOC 2 + evidence of encryption at rest + option for customer-managed KMS.

Our recommendation based on priorities: Redwood Private (VPC deployment) — gives you dedicated capacity in your VPC, customer-managed KMS, and audit logs. It's the cleanest path to meet residency/controls while keeping latency predictable.

Immediate next steps we suggested on the call:
1) I'll attach a draft SOW and high-level architecture for a VPC deployment (attached).
2) Meet with your infra/security folks to review the security pack and KMS options — proposed 30-min session.
3) If you want a lower-friction path, we can also do Dedicated (hosted dedicated capacity) as an interim while we set up the VPC.

Attachments: SOW_vpc_draft.pdf, redwood-VPC-security-pack.pdf

Would you be available next week for a 30-min review with your infra/security — Tue/Wed morning PT? If priority has shifted, let me know and I'll adjust cadence.

Thanks,

Hi Jordan — just checking in to see if this is still a priority for Acme for a Q1 pilot. I haven't heard back from LegalOps on the SOW; happy to route a lighter-weight security summary if that helps speed review.

Quick answers to your questions:
- Timeline: Yes — VPC onboarding is feasible for a Q1 pilot. We typically: scoping (2 weeks) -> deployment & config (2–4 weeks) -> validation & cutover (1–2 weeks), assuming timely access to your infra and KMS.
- Cost: For ~200 req/s sustained with a safety buffer we typically recommend a reserved pool equivalent to 8–12 high-memory GPUs; rough monthly commit range $45k–$75k depending on exact SLAs. We can refine that after a short perf/cost sizing call.
- Security: We support customer-managed KMS and HSM integrations on request. I've attached the security pack again and can have our security SE (Jonas) join the review to answer technical questions.

If it's helpful I can:
- Schedule a 30-min technical review with Jonas and your infra team (I've got Wed 11/11 9:00–10:30 PT open), or
- Start an initial scope call to finalize sizing and a draft SOW change.

Are you available to confirm priority this week? If priorities shifted, a quick note is fine and we'll re-engage when timing aligns.
